name: antenna_ball
theme: a ladybug's antenna-tip sphere becomes a whole planet, then the descent lands back in the meadow it came from

registers.name: meadow
registers.scene: a wide sunlit meadow seen low at eye level among wildflower stems and grass blades towering into golden light, gold pollen adrift in the slanted afternoon light, dew beaded on nearby leaves, a small red ladybug perched on a distant leaf across the clearing
registers.target: a round red ladybug perched on a broad green leaf, its shell a deep lacquered scarlet, neat black spots dotting its domed back
registers.loop_target: the sunlit wildflower meadow, seen low at eye level among the towering stems and grass, gold pollen adrift in slanted light

registers.name: ladybug
registers.scene: a red ladybug's domed shell fills the view, scarlet lacquer scattered with round black spots, the shell smooth and gently curved
registers.target: the ladybug's head, a small glossy black dome with faceted eyes and two slender segmented antennae curving above it

registers.name: ladybug_head
registers.scene: a ladybug's head fills the view, a glossy black dome with faceted eyes, two slender segmented antennae arcing upward, fine dark hairs along each segment
registers.target: the tip of one antenna, a small smooth black sphere

registers.name: antenna_sphere
registers.palette: glossy black and pale silver, blooming into deep blue-green
registers.scene: a smooth glossy black sphere fills the entire view, its surface deep and matte-dark, curving away into shadow at the edges

registers.name: planet
registers.scene: a vast glossy blue-green planet fills all of space, its curved limb gleaming like wet lacquer, broad white cloud bands swirled over oceans and continents, the black of space beyond
registers.target: a gap in the banded clouds below, sunlit gold-green countryside visible through the opening

registers.name: sky_clouds
registers.palette: sunlit cloud white and warm gold
registers.scene: billowing white clouds tower on either side, warm gold light pouring through the gaps onto rolling green and gold countryside below
registers.target: a single flowering treetop canopy rising from the countryside, blossoms and leaves bright in the sun

registers.name: canopy
registers.scene: a sunlit flowering treetop canopy seen from above, blossoms bright and leaves humming with insects in the warm breeze, a bright clearing visible below through a gap in the branches

music_theme: A serene, floating melody that swells with each new world, blending ethereal synths and soft orchestral strings, with a single warm bloom of sound landing on the antenna-to-planet seam.
